title: Aromatic Spicy Filipino Beef Kaldereta
description: A quick and spicy Filipino dish featuring apricot jam and bhuna, wrapped in a ti-leaf for a unique flavor and presentation. This egg-free friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the beef, cooking until browned on all sides.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside, leaving the drippings behind.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the bhuna, apricot jam, fish sauce, and black pepper to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Return the beef to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10-15 minutes, or until the beef is tender.
While the beef is cooking, prepare the ti leaves by washing and drying them thoroughly.
To serve, place a portion of the beef mixture onto a ti leaf and wrap to form a neat package.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional ti leaves if desired.
